title: SteelPermissionCollectionsConfig
description: Permission collection configuration schema for Steel

collections.description: Permission collections keyed by namespace and then by collection name

additionalProperties.description: Collection members: permission rule expressions or #namespace:name collection references

permission_rule_expression.description: Permission key with an optional namespace and an optional context selector, such as minecraft:command.give or steel:permission.manage.*.

collection_reference.description: Reference to a nested permission collection, such as #minecraft:owners.

collection_member.description: A permission rule expression or a #namespace:name nested collection reference
